Tsawwassen First Nation Lands border the north side to the west and north, and Ladner lies across the farm belt to the north, with Tsawwassen Central to the south.

The north side mixes freehold detached houses under the Single Detached Residential (RS) and Duplex (RD) zones of Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, on streets south of Highway 17, with newer strata housing around Springs Boulevard.
Tsawwassen Springs condo buildings stand at 5011 Springs Boulevard and 5055 Springs Boulevard (developer source).
Urban subdivision minimums in the applicable ladder run from RS7 at 335 square metres to RD1 at 836 square metres, with RS4 at 610, RS5 at 550 or 460 and RS6 at 390 square metres between them.
Lots fronting the farm belt and the Highway 17 corridor can be larger rural parcels rather than urban lots — confirmed parcel by parcel on the City zoning maps.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen North: rules that affect buyers

items.t: City of Delta zoning does not apply on Tsawwassen Lands: Tsawwassen First Nation is self-governing, with jurisdiction over land management on over 724 hectares transferred under the Tsawwassen First Nation Final Agreement.

The City side is planned under Delta's Official Community Plan, Bylaw No. 8400 (2024), adopted July 8, 2024. Housing Our Future is the plan's title, and it includes development permit guidelines for the Tsawwassen Urban Centre.
Confirm a parcel's zone on the City zoning maps before pricing in suite or subdivision potential, because Bylaw No. 7600 minimums range from 335 to 836 square metres in this ladder alone.
Where a property borders farm land, Agricultural Land Commission rules apply to land in the Agricultural Land Reserve (ALR), including one-residence-per-parcel limits.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen North: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: South Delta Recreation Centre at 1720 56 Street, at South Delta Exchange, is the community recreation centre serving the north side.
Tsawwassen Library, a Fraser Valley Regional Library branch at 1321A 56 Street, serves the north side from the town centre.
Highway 17A, reached from the Highway 17 corridor, leads to Highway 99 and the George Massey Tunnel toward Richmond and Vancouver.
Route 609 ties the north side together: South Delta Exchange via 52 Street and Canoe Pass Way, through Tsawwassen First Nation, to Ladner Exchange.
Route 601 runs from South Delta and Boundary Bay to Bridgeport Station via 56 Street and South Delta Exchange.
Highway 17 is the spine: west to the BC Ferries terminal, east and north via Highway 17A to Highway 99 and the George Massey Tunnel.
52 Street, 56 Street and Canoe Pass Way are the local north–south and cross-town streets the bus routes themselves trace.

blocks.text: Tsawwassen North: risks and due diligence

items.t: Establish the jurisdiction first: a lot on Tsawwassen Lands follows Tsawwassen First Nation land law, not Delta Zoning Bylaw No. 7600, and that changes tenure and servicing.
For strata product around Springs Boulevard, review the strata documents under the Strata Property Act framework; British Columbia strata disputes can go to the Civil Resolution Tribunal.
For farm-belt lots, check Agricultural Land Reserve status before picturing a second dwelling — Commission rules include one-residence-per-parcel limits on ALR land.
Flood protection here is a City system, not a lot feature: Delta operates the dikes, pump stations and drainage network, so ask what protects the specific parcel rather than the community generally.

faq.a: Ladner's, on the sample checked. For 5000 Canoe Pass Way, the School District No. North-side addresses can fall into Ladner catchments, so check the exact address instead of assuming a Tsawwassen school.
faq.q: Which schools serve a Canoe Pass Way address?

faq.a: Only if it sits on the City side of the boundary. Tsawwassen First Nation holds jurisdiction over land management on its treaty lands, over 724 hectares under the Final Agreement, separate from City of Delta zoning. Tenure, servicing and resale handling differ on Tsawwassen Lands, so establish which side of the boundary the property is on before anything else.
faq.q: Is a home beside Tsawwassen Lands under City rules?

faq.a: Fraser Health lists a South Delta After-Hours Urgent and Primary Care Centre at 1826–4949 Canoe Pass Way, on the north side's own corridor. Keep both addresses: the Canoe Pass Way centre is after-hours primary care, not a hospital emergency department.
